title: Decision: mimid-agent sets ChatContact did without advertising urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:did
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00 §Capability: a server advertising urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:did MUST also advertise urn:ietf:params:jmap:did; §Mandatory DID Methods: a server that cannot resolve did:web, did:key and did:plc MUST NOT advertise it. §Optional did field defines ChatContact.did as an optional, server-set property. Question: may mimid-agent's local JMAP endpoint set ChatContact.did for a did_webvh contact (bead mimid-1wgh.4.81.27) without advertising the capability? Readings: (a) no did at all without the capability; (b) set did, do not advertise; (c) advertise anyway. Chosen: (b). The agent resolves no DIDs (it verifies the did:webvh logs carried in MLS credentials), so (c) breaks two MUSTs; (a) hides information a client may use, and did is a server-set property a client may ignore. Recorded in mimid-agent-jmap's crate docs (# Mapping) and the commit; for the jmap-chat-did draft: say whether did may appear without the capability (handled with Mark separately; no write to jmap-chat-spec here).
close_reason: Chosen by agent (coordinator's instruction): reading (b). 3cdc553 (mimid-agent-jmap crate docs, # Mapping decision note; daemon Session unchanged). Flag to Mark.
